message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Zhao1, legal representative of a company, gave 30万元 to Zhao2, mayor, as a bribe to secure government procurement of white wine. Also the mayor had earlier directed procurement of 120万元 of white wine from the company. So the company and its legal representative gave bribe to a public official. This is "行贿" (bribery) by a non-state actor (company) to a state official. Also possibly "受贿" for the official, but the case is about the company and Zhao1. The prosecution says "被告单位肇东市福泰兴酒业有限公司、被告人赵1某的行为已构成××". So they are charging the company and its legal representative for "行贿". The official Zhao2 is a separate case. So the charge is "行贿". Also maybe "非法经营" but not indicated. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
